THISTLECOMBE COURT CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION
c/o Stannick Community Management

October 12, 2026

Unit owner: Dr. Yusuf Hartigan-Mele
Unit: B-207

NOTICE OF SPECIAL ASSESSMENT - ROOF REPLACEMENT, BUILDINGS A AND B

Dear Dr. Hartigan-Mele,

At its open meeting on September 29, 2026, the Board of Directors voted to replace the roofs on Buildings A and B and approved a special assessment to pay for the part of the work that the reserve fund cannot cover. This letter is your formal notice of that assessment.

How the amount was worked out

  Contract price for both roofs               $196,800.00
  Paid from the Association's reserve fund     $49,200.00
  Remainder to be assessed                    $147,600.00

The Declaration requires a special assessment to be divided equally among all 60 units. Each unit's share is therefore $2,460.00.

What you owe and when

The special assessment for Unit B-207 is $2,460.00. It is due in full on or before January 15, 2027.

This is a one-time charge. It is separate from your regular monthly dues of $285.00, which stay the same and remain payable on the first of each month as usual. The assessment will not be collected through your automatic dues payment. Please pay it by check payable to Thistlecombe Court Condominium Association, mailed or delivered to Stannick Community Management, or through the special assessment page of the owner portal. Write your unit number on the check.

There is no extra cost to pay by check or by electronic bank transfer on the owner portal. Owners who choose to pay by credit or debit card on the owner portal are charged a convenience fee of 2.95 percent of the payment. On the full assessment of $2,460.00, that fee is $72.57, so a card payment would come to $2,532.57. The convenience fee applies only to card payments and does not change your assessment, which is $2,460.00 however you pay.

If the assessment is not paid on time

An assessment that has not been paid in full by January 15, 2027 is delinquent. A late charge of $40.00 is added, the unpaid amount bears interest at 8 percent a year from the due date, and the Association may record a lien against the unit as the Declaration allows.

Work is scheduled to begin in March 2027, weather permitting. The contractor's schedule and the minutes of the September 29 meeting are posted on the owner portal.

For the Board of Directors,

Petra Lindahl-Osei
Community Manager, Stannick Community Management

ANNUAL ESCROW ACCOUNT REVIEW

Dear Mirela Kovac-Dunne,

Each year we review the escrow account that we use to pay the property taxes and homeowners insurance on your home. This statement covers two separate things: a refund we are sending to you, and the monthly payment you will make to us starting in January.

1. A REFUND TO YOU

Your homeowners insurance premium for the past year was lower than we had planned for, so your escrow account now holds more than it needs. After keeping the cushion that federal rules allow, the extra amount, called a surplus, is $286.14.

The surplus is your money, and we are returning it to you. A check for $286.14, payable to you, is enclosed with this statement. You can deposit or cash it as you would any other check.

2. YOUR MONTHLY PAYMENT STARTING JANUARY 2027

These are the amounts we expect to pay from your escrow account between January and December 2027:

  Hartwell County property taxes                $3,842.16
  Homeowners insurance, Allbright Mutual        $1,569.00
  Total projected escrow payments               $5,411.16

To cover these, your monthly escrow deposit will be $450.93, which is the total divided by 12.

  Principal and interest                        $1,161.47
  Escrow deposit                                  $450.93
  Monthly payment                               $1,612.40

Your monthly payment of $1,612.40 begins with the payment due January 1, 2027, and is due on the first of each month after that. The principal and interest part of your payment does not change.

Please send each payment from January 1, 2027 onward for the full amount of $1,612.40.

KEEP THE REFUND AND YOUR PAYMENT SEPARATE

The refund check is not a credit toward your mortgage payment. Do not subtract $286.14 from your January payment, and do not send the refund check back to us as a payment.

If you have questions about this statement, call the Escrow Department at the number shown on your monthly mortgage statement.

Escrow Department
Hollinshead Home Loans

YOUR LEASE IS ENDING - WHAT TO DO BEFORE DECEMBER 18

Dear Benedikt Asher-Lowe,

Your 36-month lease reaches its maturity date on Friday, December 18, 2026. By that date you need to do one of two things: turn the vehicle in, or buy it. This letter explains both, and what happens if you do neither.

IF YOU TURN THE VEHICLE IN

1. Book the free pre-return inspection. It is optional, but we suggest having it done at least 15 days before maturity, that is, by December 3, 2026, so that you have time to arrange any repairs yourself.
2. Return the vehicle, both keys and the owner's manual to any authorized Corvell dealer on or before December 18, 2026, and sign the odometer statement there.
3. After the return we will send you a final bill. It will include the $395.00 disposition fee set in your lease, 20 cents for each mile over your 36,000-mile allowance, and a charge for any wear beyond normal use. We cannot work out the mileage and wear charges until the vehicle has been returned and inspected.

IF YOU BUY THE VEHICLE

Your purchase option price is $14,275.00. Sales tax, title and registration fees are extra and differ from state to state, so that figure is not your final cost. Call us for a payoff quote, which is good for 10 days. The purchase must be completed by December 18, 2026. No disposition fee is charged on a purchase.

IF YOU DO NEITHER

The lease does not simply end. If the vehicle has not been returned or purchased by December 18, 2026, you will be charged a holdover payment equal to your monthly payment of $318.44 for each month, or part of a month, that you keep it. We may also treat the lease as in default and take the vehicle back at your expense.

Lease Maturity Center
Halcyard Motor Finance

PORT OF SALTERHEAD
Harbor Office - Moorage Services

October 15, 2026

Tobiah Marchetti-Rowe
Waiting list record: WL-30-0672

ANNUAL WAITING LIST CONFIRMATION - 30-FOOT SLIPS

Dear Mr. Marchetti-Rowe,

You are on the Port's waiting list for a permanent 30-foot slip in the Salterhead Boat Basin. As of October 1 you were number 41 on that list. Twelve slips of this size changed hands during the past year.

Once a year we ask everyone on the list to tell us whether they still want a slip. This keeps the list accurate and means that offers go to people who are ready to take them.

To stay on the list, you must confirm by Friday, November 6, 2026. You can do this in either of two ways:

  - sign and return the confirmation card enclosed with this letter, or
  - sign in to the Moorage Services page of the Port's website and choose the waiting list confirmation option.

There is no charge to confirm. The $80.00 waiting list deposit you paid when you joined the list in 2022 stays on file and will be credited to your first month's moorage when you accept a slip.

If you do not confirm by the date above, your name will be removed from the waiting list and your deposit will be forfeited. A person who has been removed and later wants a slip must send in a new application with a new deposit and starts again at the bottom of the list.

Please also check that the boat details and mailing address printed on the card are current, and correct anything that has changed.

Port policy on unconfirmed names. Under Moorage Rule 7.4, a name that is not confirmed during the annual review is placed in inactive status. It keeps its place in line and its deposit remains on file, but no slip is offered while the name is inactive. The holder may return to active status at any time by notifying the Harbor Office.

Harbor Office - Moorage Services
Port of Salterhead
